description: Calendar date to which the guest counts apply (documented as string YYYY/M/D). International: one row per nationality per date. Domestic: exactly one row per date.
TARGET VARIABLE. Total number of guests recorded for the nationality (international) or in total (domestic) on the given date.
Guests newly arrived (check-in) on the date, as opposed to continuing stays. Always a subset of Guests.
Guests who visited and departed on the same day without an overnight stay. International: '*' indicates zero, suppressed, or not applicable. Domestic: documented as always numeric.
High-level residence group: 'International' (non-resident visitor) in the international files, 'Domestic' (resident / in-country) in the domestic files.
